system.description: All it takes is a single strike to completely break an enemies flow, stopping them in their tracks and bringing them to their knees. When you use this technique, they must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are Flow Broken. Once you use this Martial Technique you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

activities.label: Flow Breaker
activities.text: On an unarmed or Taijutsu hit that deals unarmed damage. Not again until the end of your next turn. A failure applies the condition card (ends at the end of the creature's next turn).

rules.text: Flow Broken is a condition card (Class & Clan Conditions): its rules are on the card. From 6th level (Talented Genius, Perfected Stillness) it lasts until a save at the end of each of the creature's turns: at the table.
